text:
The purpose of this meeting was to review current operations for the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways and align on service flow, handoffs, and passenger support.

Attendees were Caleb Berg, Mateo Park, and Maggie.

The team began with a calm review of passenger guidance, noting that the process should stay clear and consistent so travelers feel supported from booking through arrival. <<FACT F097>> The group agreed that written reminders should stay concise and friendly, especially when passengers are arranging travel for animals that may need extra care. There was also agreement that the desk should keep passenger questions moving smoothly and avoid unnecessary back-and-forth.

On transfer handling, the staff discussed when to escalate a case and how to keep notes complete for the next person in the chain. <<FACT F106>> The discussion emphasized steady communication, especially when a situation needs a quicker handoff or a careful follow-up. The team also noted that cabin coordination should remain closely tied to the desk so that in-flight monitoring reflects the passenger plan prepared earlier.

For check-in, the group reviewed the steps that should be confirmed before acceptance and boarding. <<FACT F092>> The team agreed that early reminders, clear document checks, and a reassuring tone help reduce stress for both passengers and animals. A final round of comments focused on keeping records tidy and making sure each case is easy to trace during the journey.

The meeting ended with shared agreement on the action points and a positive commitment to keep service practical and warm.
